turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
I will do one first.
"He has an apple." Apple starts with "a", a vowel sound. So: an apple.
Rule: use an before a vowel sound; use a before other sounds.
Right: She has a pen. Wrong: She has an pen.

Now you try. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
